001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory;
002
003import com.google.common.collect.MapMaker;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
007
008import java.util.Map;
009
010public class InventoryWrapperRegistry {
011
012  private final Map<String, InventoryWrapperManager> registry = new MapMaker().makeMap();
013
014  @Nullable
015  public String find(final InventoryWrapperManager manager) {
016
017    for(final Map.Entry<String, InventoryWrapperManager> entry : registry.entrySet()) {
018      if(entry.getValue() == manager || entry.getValue().equals(manager)) {
019        return entry.getKey();
020      }
021    }
022    return null;
023  }
024
025  @Nullable
026  public InventoryWrapperManager get(final String pluginName) {
027
028    return registry.get(pluginName);
029  }
030
031  public void register(@NotNull final Plugin plugin, @NotNull final InventoryWrapperManager manager) {
032
033    if(registry.containsKey(plugin.getName())) {
034      plugin.getLogger().warning("Nag Author: Plugin " + plugin.getName() + " already have a registered InventoryWrapperManager: "
035                                 + registry.get(plugin.getName()).getClass().getName() +
036                                 " but trying register another new manager: " + manager.getClass().getName() +
037                                 ". This may cause unexpected behavior! Replacing with new instance...");
038    }
039    registry.put(plugin.getName(), manager);
040  }
041
042  public void unregister(@NotNull final Plugin plugin) {
043
044    registry.remove(plugin.getName());
045  }
046
047}
